rules.question: On the Path Builder's screen, has the player saved enough Star Power phrases to activate at a fill?
rules.owner: fill_reason in src/pathbuilder/pb_text.cpp, which reads the Preview's meter at the fill (bars_saved_at) against kSpActivationBars once, to say why a fill cannot be activated
rules.decision: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-path-builder-redesign.md, PB-5 "Scan rows" and "Engine truth, not mockup shortcuts", approved by the user on 2026-10-30 ("Yes, as recommended")
must_match: const bool can = kSpActivationBars <= app::sp_meter_bars_at(scene.sp_meter, ms);

owner_lines.why: fill_reason, the owner: a fill the engine did not offer, under two saved phrases

rules.note: Whether the player could activate at a fill is the engine's answer (branch_activate, read through the fill's PreviewFillState), never the screen's count of phrases; the mockup's shortcut of counting phrases is what the plan forbids. The builder and the timeline may write kSpActivationBars as a figure (the timeline's activate line and the Saved label's hover line) but compare it only in fill_reason, which reads the meter to say why an unoffered fill cannot be taken. The pattern flags a comparison operator on either side of the constant. A scope names a top folder or a single file (OwnerRule::scope), so the row lists each file under src/pathbuilder; a new file there joins the list. Decided by: the PB-5 scan rows in the plan.
